stories.title: Top-seeded Zverev narrowly survives 1st round
stories.summary: Alexander Zverev rallied just in time to avoid becoming the first men's No. 1 seed to lose in the first round of a Grand Slam tournament since 2003, edging Lorenzo Sonego.

stories.title: Reports: Van Noy, 35, secures deal with Vikings
stories.summary: The Vikings agreed Tuesday night to sign 13-year outside linebacker Kyle Van Noy, according to multiple reports, a 35-year-old veteran with 57 career sacks, who will provide Minnesota with some needed depth and experience at the edge rusher position.

stories.title: Court docs: Tiger plans to change plea in DUI case
stories.summary: Court documents show that Tiger Woods plans to change his not guilty plea in a DUI case stemming from a rollover crash in Florida.
